Techno-Functional Leader in Retail, Corporate and Investment Banking
Modernization, Client Onboarding, Digital Banking in driving digital
transformation across client onboarding, account opening, and channel
enablement. Proven track record of aligning complex technical roadmaps with
commercial objectives to evolve legacy core banking monoliths into cloud-native,
API-driven ecosystems in agile environment.
Strategic Architecture & Compliance Delivery: Expert in architecting API-first
strategies and RESTful microservices that convert intricate business
requirements into scalable, system-agnostic solutions. Successfully compresses
corporate client time-to-transact while ensuring strict adherence to global
regulatory frameworks.
Ecosystem Integration & Compliance: Expert at integrating mission-critical
subsystems—such as KYC/AML and Account Aggregators—into unified
ecosystems. I embed IT Audit and Regulatory governance into the product
lifecycle to ensure secure, compliant, and frictionless global workflows.
Global Delivery & Synergy: Proven ability to unify business, tech, and
compliance teams within multi-vendor, multi-geography environments. I lead
cross-functional global teams to transform high-stakes challenges into
measurable business outcomes through disciplined Agile execution and
customer-centric design and cross functional collaboration with stake holders.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Digital Transformation Consultant Consultant, Bangalore – India | 2025 – Till date
Providing end-to-end design of system-agnostic digital solutions, Human-in-
the-Loop (HITL) frameworks that safely integrate AI/ML capabilities into core
banking processes. Specially, simplifying customer onboarding and loan-
origination journeys.
Developed comprehensive business cases and documentation to secure
executive buy-in and provide a clear blueprint for enterprise-wide digital initiatives.
Principal Analyst / Product Owner / Business Systems Analyst FIS, Bangalore – India | 2016 – 2025
Orchestrated end-to-end digital product lifecycles for Corporate & Investment Banking
platforms, supporting Bank of America digital banking modernization, institutional client
onboarding, investment product servicing, and API-led transformation.
Owned the product backlog and technical grooming sessions for a cross-functional
team of engineers, translating complex financial workflows into actionable user
stories, sequence diagrams, and system architecture specifications.
• Directly managed multi-country transformation initiatives, unifying business,
technology, and global vendors to ensure alignment with diverse international
regulatory requirements.
• Designed an enterprise-wide exception management and error-handling framework, standardizing governance
and drastically improving audit readiness across banking subsystems.
Optimized global delivery velocity through precision backlog refinement and sprint governance, driving alignment on
scope and acceptance criteria across onshore/offshore teams.
Spearheaded real-time KYC/AML and third-party integrations, delivering compliant, frictionless workflows within a
secure, API-driven ecosystem.
Wrapped siloed legacy systems in modern API contracts, transforming a disjointed, manual corporate
onboarding process into a seamless, automated digital journey and omni channel experience.

Led Product Owner activities for Corporate & Investment Banking digital transformation initiatives across client onboarding and account servicing.
Defined business requirements and user stories for institutional client onboarding and KYC/AML workflows. • Worked with Investment Banking operations teams to digitize client onboarding, entitlement management, and regulatory compliance.
Collaborated with global business stakeholders to deliver API-driven solutions supporting institutional banking products. • Supported onboarding of corporate and institutional clients through automated workflow orchestration and compliance integration.
Worked with payment, treasury, and investment banking stakeholders to modernize enterprise banking platforms. • Collaborated with Bank of America stakeholders to modernize digital banking and legacy banking platforms through Product Owner-led transformation initiatives.
Supported institutional banking product enhancements involving equity products, investment product workflows, and corporate actions, translating business requirements into user stories and functional specifications.
Supported trade validation, trade enrichment, post-trade processing, and client servicing workflows for institutional banking platforms.
Partnered with Investment Banking operations, technology, and compliance teams to deliver secure onboarding, entitlement management, and servicing capabilities for institutional clients.
Contributed to modernization initiatives supporting investment product servicing, corporate actions processing, and client lifecycle management within enterprise banking ecosystems.
Project Manager Consulting, India | 2014 – 2015
Provided strategic project management consulting to drive short-term banking modernization initiatives, aligning technology upgrades with business objectives, engineered rigorous test plans and execution strategies to independently validate with functional requirements.
Architected and implemented remediation frameworks to eliminate critical IT control gaps, substantially
strengthening the organization’s overall governance and risk posture.
Redesigned privileged access & control framework resolving long-standing governance deficiencies.
Project Manager SBG, Jeddah – Saudi Arabia | 2010 – 2014
Led end-to-end Oracle ERP implementations, orchestrating the decommissioning of legacy systems to streamline
global enterprise operations and data integrity.
Pioneered an enterprise-wide change management framework, significantly enhancing audit readiness and
governance across complex regulatory environments.
Directed IT audit methodology development, leveraging advanced tools to strengthen control effectiveness, risk
mitigation, and compliance reporting.
Application Analyst / Product Owner Qatar First Investment Bank, Doha - Qatar | 2009 – 2009
•
Implemented IAM for granular entitlement structures (e.g., Maker-Checker workflows, tiered payment authorization limits) for corporate clients.
• Managed end-to-end SIT/UAT phases, validating that technical deployments met the business requirements.
• Led the implementation Asset Management Services, Operating Lease, Mortgage products for the new bank.
Product Owner for Asset Management and Mortgage products supporting an Investment Banking platform. • Managed product backlog, business requirements, SIT/UAT, and production readiness. • Designed authorization workflows including Maker-Checker, entitlement hierarchy, and approval matrices for institutional clients. • Partnered with business users to automate investment banking operational workflows. • Delivered secure onboarding capabilities for high-value institutional customers.
Application Analyst SAMBA Financial Group, Riyadh – Saudi Arabia | 2007 – 2008
Orchestrated the technical carve-out of a banking entity, delivering a standalone General Ledger (GL) and complex
data migration for a Capital & Investment Management entity.
Played a pivotal role in implementing of multi-currency mutual fund products, equities, corporate actions,
ensuring regulatory requirements are met with seamless transaction processing
Partnered with Compliance and Legal stakeholders to integrate real-time, automated AML/KYC screening vendors collaborated with Corporate Operations, and Risk to align the onboarding product roadmap with high-value institutional pipeline priorities. Implemented Investment Management solutions supporting Equity products and Mutual Fund operations.
• Worked on Corporate Actions processing supporting dividend, bonus, rights issue, and stock split events. • Participated in business analysis for Equity transaction processing and investment product servicing. Supported investment product onboarding and lifecycle management for institutional customers. • • Coordinated with Compliance and Operations teams to ensure AML/KYC adherence for investment products.
IT Analyst / Programmer Saudi Hollandi Bank, Riyadh – Saudi Arabia | 2002 – 2007

Integrated complex payment gateways and credit bureau systems, optimizing real-time transaction accuracy and speed across multiple digital channels.
Engineered the Bank Master Application (Kindle/Misys) using C and Pro*C, architecting flexible interfaces to meet evolving regulatory requirements, eliminating operational bottlenecks and ensuring end-to-end data integrity across the enterprise.
